title: Business Risk Team Lead
description: Overview: Implement defined first line of defense risk management initiatives within the business unit in support of the Enterprise Risk Framework. Manage the risk work and coordinate with individuals responsible for risk and control functions in the business unit. Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for execution of risk functions; Serve as project leader on complex and highly visible risk management projects. Primary Responsibilities: Responsible for the execution of risk initiatives that this position leads or for which their team is responsible to conduct. Responsible for completely and accurately documenting key business processes. Identify and assess risks and internal controls associated with the key processes under your leadership. Actively participate in the planning, execution and reporting of the business unit's risk-based testing program. Perform control testing as an individual contributor and ensure control testing is performed for the team's risk initiatives in accordance with M&T's First Line of Defense Guidance on Management of Risks & Internal Controls and professional standards. Specific control testing responsibilities will involve the review of testing , and evaluating results to determine if issues exist. Responsibilities may also include independent performance of scripted testing as well as system administrative duties such as the maintenance, validation, and / or updating in the compliance data management system (Archer). Communicate findings to management. Monitor business unit performance with respect to established key risk indicators (KRIs), and recommend enhancements to strengthen risk control structure. Accurately complete Risk Control Self Assessments (RCSAs) and other risk management reporting, recommending enhancements to each. Assist in the reporting and escalation of risk events and loss events. Identify emerging risks and risks associated with new products/ services/ markets/ channels or changes to existing products/ services/ markets/ channels, as well as the control structures needed to mitigate the risks. Provide guidance on the development of remediation plans. Manage the timely completion of remediation plans and other projects to address issues identified internally and by Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit or external regulators. Validate the quality of the plans implemented. Implement and oversee the adherence to policies and procedures for the business unit. This includes identifying updates or enhancements as business unit processes change. In addition, assist in responding to both internal and external requests in relation to departmental processes and procedures. Adhere to applicable compliance/operational risk controls in accordance with Company or regulatory standards and policies. Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand. Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned. Education and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 years' relevant work experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 9 years' higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 5 years' relevant work experience Education and Experience Preferred: Minimum of 2 years’ experience working in risk identification, risk mitigation, risk and control self-assessment, or related disciplines Experience in understanding [ Corporate Services (Third Party Risk Management, Corporate Real Estate, and the like) / Community Markets (CRA, Foundation, Sustainability)] and the Compliance and Operational risks associated therein is helpful M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $89,600.00 - $149,300.00 Annual (USD). title: Technology & Cyber Risk, VP
description: Who We Are Enterprise Technology Risk Management (ETRM) is part of State Street’s Enterprise Risk Management organization. As a Second Line of Defense function, ETRM provides independent oversight, monitoring, effective challenge, and guidance related to technology and cybersecurity risk. Who We Are Looking For We are seeking an experienced Cyber & Technology Risk Vice President to serve as the primary technology risk partner for State Street’s newly established Wealth Services business. This is a hands-on role responsible for coordinating and managing cyber and technology risk oversight activities for Wealth Services. The successful candidate will work closely with Wealth Services Risk Management, business leaders, technology teams, and other risk partners to identify, assess, monitor, challenge, escalate, and report technology and cybersecurity risks. The ideal candidate will bring more than 10 years of experience in Technology and Cybersecurity Risk, including experience within Wealth Management. Strong knowledge of technology and operational resilience is also important. Candidates may come from first-line Technology Risk, second-line risk oversight, or Technology Audit, provided they have direct experience assessing and challenging technology and cybersecurity risks. This role requires someone who can independently manage complex risk activities, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, and translate technical issues into clear business and risk implications. Why This Role Is Important to Us Wealth Services is a new strategic business for State Street. This newly created role offers the opportunity to help establish and mature its cyber and technology risk oversight capabilities as the business, technology environment, and risk profile continue to develop. As the primary ETRM contact for Wealth Services, the successful candidate will provide independent oversight and effective challenge while helping the business identify and manage technology, cybersecurity, and resilience risks. The role will also support clear risk reporting to senior management, governance committees, and other stakeholders. What You Will Be Responsible For As Cyber & Technology Risk, Vice President – Wealth Services, you will: Serve as the primary ETRM point of contact for the Wealth Services business and its Risk Management team. title: Senior Paid Social Manager
description: A BOUT TIDE At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. Tide facts: Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing Over $300 million raised in funding 3,000 Tideans globally Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026 We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg About You We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well. You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling. You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business. Some of the things you’ll be doing: Owning and scaling paid social performance globally , ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms. Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets , using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth. Building an AI-enabled paid social team , deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way. Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows , using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks. Using AI and automation across the account , from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work. Developing and executing the paid social roadmap , identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms. Driving a full-funnel approach , from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights. Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives. Championing attribution and measurement , ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation. Leading creative strategy , working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance. Staying ahead of industry changes , including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), AI-driven platform updates , and new advertising solutions. Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team , shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally. You’ll be a great fit if: You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms. You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social. You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices. You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms. You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making. You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.). You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation. You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain. You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it. You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services. You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels. You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation. You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories. You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment. You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals. Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable. What you’ll get in return: Make work, work for you! We embrace flexible working and remote-first arrangements. 25 days holiday + bank holidays. Vitality Health and Dental Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical well-being. £1,000 L&D budget per year, plus up to three L&D paid days off. Enhanced family-friendly leave. Work abroad for up to 90 days a year. Snacks, drinks, and social events in our offices. Tidean Ways of Working At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK.   TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.  We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.   At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. title: Lead Country Commercial Manager for Business Management Software
description: A BOUT TIDE At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. Tide facts: Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing Over $300 million raised in funding 3,000 Tideans globally Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026 We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg About the team  The Business Management Software commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners. This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention.  About the role  We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Country Commercial Manager to scale revenue growth across our Accounting, Tax and Payroll products (part of our BMS suite, known internally as ‘Admin Services’) and build an indirect distribution channel via Partners & Accountants. You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams (mainly Marketing, Product, Finance) to understand funnel conversion, campaign(s) performance and product prioritisation, whilst owning competitor and market insight and leading new product go-to-market (GTM) launch plans. Excellent organisation, strategy and communication skills essential. Key areas of this role: Revenue Ownership & Forecasting : Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine commercial projections for the Accounting, Tax & Payroll products ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities. Accountants Strategy & GTM planning : Research UK Accountants market and build a clear, concise and financially robust indirect model to help Tide scale their BMS products and others with Accountants. Competitor and Market insight: Regularly analyse key competitor movements and wider industry trends - relevant to Accounting, Tax, Payroll and Accountants - translating insight into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition. Analytics-Driven Insight: Analyse (via BI team) member behaviour, segment audiences, subscription cohort performance and create clear recommendations to shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications. Product Development:  Partner with the Product teams to assess opportunities to shape product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting  successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies. Launch Strategy : Support new feature launches across channels and operational teams to deliver best-in-class experiments.  Stakeholder Management:  High levels of communication with a wide range of stakeholders, including Tide’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives. Member Obsession: You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions. What we are looking for  Strong commercial acumen :  Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.  Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals. Accountancy software experience : Understanding of software and experience scaling software at either an Accountancy software company or with Accountants. 5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.   This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact. Strong analytical mindset : Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans. Proven GTM track record – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns  (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points) Exceptional project management skills , able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment. Creative collaborator: Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence. Self-starter attitude : Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift. What you’ll get in return Competitive salary  Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.) 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days Professional L&D budget per year Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide  Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar Enhanced family-friendly leave 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes) Sabbatical leave  TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.  We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.   At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.   Disclaimer   It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities.
